faq.title: Everything you need to know
faq.lead: Clients and developers: answers to the most common questions.

items.q: Is posting a project really free?
items.a: Yes. Posting is free and requires no subscription. Developers choose a plan with a monthly contact quota.

items.q: How long does it take to receive proposals?
items.a: Most projects receive their first proposals within 24 hours. Posting takes about 2 minutes.
No. Devmarket takes no commission on the project: you pay the developer directly.

items.q: How do I choose the right developer?
items.a: Each profile shows a portfolio, skills, a rating and a starting rate. Compare proposals and chat in the inbox.

items.q: How does the developer subscription system work?
items.a: Choose the plan that fits your activity: Pro (2,500 FCFA/month · 80 contacts/month), Pro Max (7,000 FCFA/month · 200 contacts/month) or Agency (15,000 FCFA/month · 400 contacts/month), with 20% off on annual billing.

items.q: Does Devmarket take a commission on my projects?
items.a: No, 0% commission. You negotiate and invoice your client directly.

items.q: What happens if I reach my monthly contact quota?
items.a: You are never charged automatic overage fees. You are notified at 80%, 90% and 100% of your quota and can upgrade to a higher plan anytime.

items.q: Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
items.a: Yes, all plans are no-commitment and can be cancelled in one click from your account.

faq.intro: Everything you need to know before posting your first project, or answering your first project as a developer.

groups.title: For clients
groups.text: Posting a project is free and takes 2 minutes. You receive quotes from verified developers, then choose freely — with no commission.

groups.title: For developers
groups.text: Each project shows its budget and region. You send your proposal using your monthly contact quota. Zero commission on the project.

groups.title: Private conversations
groups.text: Everything happens in the built-in messenger: quotes, project details, questions. Your WhatsApp stays hidden until you agree to share it.

faqs.a: Devmarket is the marketplace for web projects in francophone West Africa: clients post their website project for free, verified developers send quotes, and you pick the right one.

The client posts their project in 2 minutes: type of site, budget and region. The project appears in the project list. The interested developer spends your monthly subscription quota to send a proposal and open a private conversation with the client, then the exchange continues directly on the platform.

faqs.q: How much does a subscriptions cost?
faqs.a: your monthly subscription quota. Registration and project posting are free: only developers buy monthly contacts to answer projects or unlock a contact.

faqs.q: How do I pay for my subscriptions?
faqs.a: Payment is made online from your wallet: top it up, then spend your monthly contacts anywhere on the site. As soon as the payment is confirmed, your monthly contacts are credited to your account automatically.

faqs.q: Does my WhatsApp number stay private?
faqs.a: Yes. Your number never appears on projects or in search results: exchanges go through the built-in messenger, and you alone decide when to share your contact.

faqs.q: Which countries is the service available in?
faqs.a: Worldwide: every country and region is available at signup, and prices are shown in your local currency (FCFA, USD, EUR, …).

Yes: a worldwide ranking, rewarded every month. The top 3 receive 10, 7 and 4 monthly contacts, you need at least 2 projects completed and confirmed in the month to appear in it, and each completed project is worth 50 points.

faqs.q: Is there a commission on projects?
faqs.a: No. Devmarket takes no commission on projects: the developer and the client deal directly, with no middleman.

terms.metaDesc: The rules for using the Devmarket service: projects, subscriptions and matching.
terms.title: Terms of use
terms.lead: By using Devmarket, you accept the following rules.

s1.b: Devmarket is a matching service between clients who post their website project for free and developers who unlock the contact with their subscription.

s2.b:
Posting a project is free and reserved for people able to take on the commitments described.

  • the information provided must be accurate;
  • the project must be real and serious;
  • any abusive or fraudulent use is penalized by account deletion.

s3.b:
Developers get a monthly contact quota included in their plan (Free, Pro, Pro Max or Agency).

  • each proposal on a project consumes one contact from your quota;
  • the quota resets every month;
  • paid plans are billed monthly, with no commitment.

s4.b: Direct contact with the client is the very purpose of the service: the developer who unlocks a project with their contact quota obtains the contact and continues the exchange in the built-in messenger, then directly (WhatsApp) after mutual agreement. Developers and clients are responsible for their exchanges and for concluding their own contract. Devmarket takes no part in financial transactions between the parties and charges no commission.

s5.b:
• no spam, harassment or off-topic solicitation;
  • no resale of unlocked contacts to third parties;
  • every report is reviewed by the team.

s6.b: The content of a project belongs to its author (the client). Developers may use it solely to respond to that project. The Devmarket brand, texts and visual identity may not be reused without written permission.

s7.b:
A contact consumed on a project cannot be refunded. In case of a fraudulent contact or a fictitious project, the report must be made within the 48 hours following the unlocking of the contact.

Reports are made from the conversation via the “Report” button. The team reviews the exchanges and refunds the contact if the dispute is confirmed.

s8.b: Devmarket provides a matching service. The quality of the work delivered, adherence to deadlines and project content are the sole responsibility of the developer, and the accuracy of the project that of the client. Our liability is limited to the amounts paid to Devmarket.

s9.b: Devmarket evolves continuously: pricing, rules and features may change. The terms in force are those published on this page. Using the service after an update constitutes acceptance of the new rules.

s10.b: To report abuse, fraud or a breach of these terms, write to us at contact@devmarket.com or use the report button present on each piece of content.

s11.b: All legal notifications are addressed to contact@devmarket.com. Please keep valid access to your login email address.

s12.b: Devmarket may suspend any account in case of non-compliance with these terms, and reserves the right to evolve the service and its pricing. In the event of a dispute, Senegalese law applies and the courts of Dakar have jurisdiction.

privacy.metaDesc: How Devmarket collects, uses and protects your personal data.
privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.lead: Your data, your privacy: here is how Devmarket handles them.

s1.b:
When you use the service, we collect:

  • your project data: name, region, project type, budget and description;
  • your WhatsApp number, used for direct contact;
  • navigation data strictly necessary for operation.

s2.h: Why do we collect this data?
s2.b:
This data is used solely to:

  • match clients and developers;
  • let you unlock a contact on a project;
  • ensure moderation and prevent abuse.

We do not sell your data, and we never share it for advertising purposes.

s3.b: A project's contact (WhatsApp number) is only visible to developers who unlock the contact on the project. No other disclosure is made without your consent.

s4.b: Data is kept for as long as necessary to provide the service: your session stays active for 30 days (see the cookie policy), your projects stay visible while they are open, and account data is deleted upon request. Security logs are kept for 12 months, then anonymized.

s5.b: Our infrastructure is hosted with a web provider such as Supabase (database, authentication, storage). These providers may not use your data for their own purposes and only access it to ensure the proper functioning of the service.

s6.b:
We apply technical and organizational measures suited to the sensitivity of the data:

  • passwords hashed, never stored in plaintext;
  • secure sessions with httpOnly cookies;
  • data access restricted by role (client or developer);
  • WhatsApp hidden by default, revealed only during a conversation.

s7.b: The service is reserved for people able to take on contractual commitments. A minor may not use Devmarket without the consent of a legal representative.

s8.b: The cookies we use serve exclusively for authentication and technical operation. They are never used for advertising purposes.

s9.b: Under Senegalese law No. 2008-12 on the protection of personal data, you may request access to, rectification or deletion of your data by writing to contact@devmarket.com.

cookies.metaDesc: How Devmarket uses cookies and trackers to run the service and keep you signed in.
cookies.title: Cookie policy
cookies.lead: We keep your session signed in with cookies, and nothing else.

groups.name: Essential authentication cookies
groups.description: Created by Supabase Auth, they keep your session active and secure (30 days). Deleted when you sign out. They are strictly necessary for the service: without them, signing in or accessing your space is impossible.

groups.name: Next.js technical cookies
groups.description: Used only for rendering pages and navigation. No personal data is stored in them.

groups.name: Local preferences (localStorage)
groups.description: Interface settings such as “reduce animations” are stored on your device. They never leave your browser.

groups.name: No advertising or tracking cookies
groups.description: Devmarket does not use targeted advertising, does not pass any cookie to ad networks and does not resell any data.

s1.b: A cookie is a small file stored by your browser. At Devmarket, cookies serve one single purpose: keeping you signed in securely for up to 30 days, as you requested.

s3.b:
By default, when you sign in, a session cookie with a duration of 30 days is set. You stay signed in between visits, so you do not have to type your password again.

You can end this session at any time using the “Sign out” button in the navigation bar: the cookie is then immediately deleted from your device.

s4.b: Essential authentication cookies do not require consent: they are indispensable to the service. Local preferences can be erased at any time from your browser settings. If you block all cookies, signing in to Devmarket will be impossible.

s5.b: A question about this policy? Write to us at contact@devmarket.com.
